description: Use when the user asks why AI describes their brand a certain way, or why it recommends a rival. Returns Parse's standing insights (what is still true of the brand) and the last two weeks of insights as short claims. Next, on Pro: parse_evidence with an insight's id reads the answers behind it, and a standing insight that has a `card` opens with parse_dashboard_standing.

brandSlug.description: The brand's slug or its name. Omit it to use the workspace's own brand.

name: parse_why
title: Why AI says this about the brand
